description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012270

The Bunny Graveyard comes to PlayStation 5! Dive into a pixel-art horror adventure where you play as a cursor pulled into a mysterious digital world. Your mission: find Skye, the bunny, while surviving strange entities that don’t want you to escape.

Explore new areas, make friends (or foes...) and experience a variety of fun minigames, from fishing and gardening to underground fights. Make choices that shape your interactions, uncover hidden secrets, collect figurines, and enjoy action-packed animated cutscenes. 

In this world, nothing is as it seems, and every discovery brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind The Bunny Graveyard. Releasing April 9th on PS5!
